name: Snow Hearth Primer (Tuyết Táo Quyết)
concept: The outer gate's method, learned in the kitchens and at the snow pits. A Fire root breathes the heat that comes up through the valley floor; a Water root breathes the melt that runs off the snow above it. Either carries a disciple through the six layers. The sixth layer is the Winter Coal: the disciple keeps one coal alive in a snowbank from the first snow to the thaw, feeding it nothing but breath. A Fire root that holds 45 then walks into the furnace hall. A Water root goes to the snow jackets or the boats.
lore: Written in 1145 by Tần Tuyết Thán at Đồng Hồng Lô's order (N-hong_lo-04), the winter the gate was opened to Water roots. The old primer was the founder's, taught only to Fire roots, and it is still read aloud in the kitchens on the first day of snow.

name: Water Over Fire Canon (Ký Tế Lô Kinh)
concept: The valley's alchemy, named for the hexagram Ký Tế (既濟), water above fire: the pot is finished. Volcanic fire is too hot for herbs. The alchemist runs snow-melt through copper jackets around the furnace and holds the flame at the edge of boiling, which lets one furnace brew two batches in a season without spoiling either. The danger is the moment the balance tips. In a fight it is a method of opposites: Fire hits that the holder's own Water cools into healing, and Water hits that the holder's Fire turns to scalding steam.
lore: The founder Tiết Thừa Hỏa (tiet_thua_hoa) brought only fire from the isles in 650. The water came later. Đồng Hồng Lô (dong_hong_lo) first ran snow through the jackets in 930 to keep the furnace lit through his nine years of mourning (A028), and the canon grew out of that habit. Tần Tuyết Thán wrote down its last three layers. The elders still argue over whether it belongs to the head or to her.

name: Whale Road Harpoon (Kình Lộ Tiêu Pháp)
concept: The sea hunters' art from Kình Cốt Đường, carried into the valley in 884 (V013). The hunter throws a line of Water qi with the spear, so a struck foe's soonest art waits 0.3 s. It was made for spirit whales and works on anything that tries to run. Hồng Lô's boat crews use it to hold their boats in the swell off the volcanic isles while the alchemists gather ash.
lore: Nghiêu Phá Lãng (nghieu_pha_lang), the last head of Kình Cốt Đường, went out on the whale road after a great spirit whale in 884 and did not come back. His hunters brought the art to Hồng Lô with their boats. Until 1145 it was taught only in Bồ Diệp Thôn, outside the gate.

name: Broth-Kettle Breath (Phủ Thang Thổ Nạp Pháp)
concept: The kitchen servants' method at the mouth of the Red Furnace, for thin roots who tend the whale-broth pot day and night without entering the outer gate. They breathe the rising steam and kitchen warmth to keep their bodies whole through winter shifts.
lore: Kept in the valley kitchens since the founder's day; Dương Bát Oản teaches it beside the broth ladle to every kitchen hand who cannot hold a Winter Coal.

name: Satchel Hall Healing Canon (Thanh Nang Dưỡng Mạch Kinh)
concept: Thanh Nang Đường's quiet Wood-and-Water healing method, carried north to Hồng Lô Cốc by Giải Bách Bộ in 1101 (V018) and kept under yearly exception in the Satchel Hall without ever entering the furnace lineage.
lore: Copied into green-bound ledgers that smell of pine smoke and dried stemona root; Giải Bách Bộ teaches it only to her apprentice Cúc Xa Tiền.
